facts.continuation: Equality requires declared mask1 or3, then scalar parameter return; continuation guarded parameter reference if mask1, or existing group/call/coalesce expression with exact actual flow mask2 if mask3. Inequality requires declared mask1, then direct guarded parameter at mask0, continuation direct distinct scalar parameter. No else; all then blocks contain exactly one terminating return. Branch proof map is local and read only; declaration masks unchanged. Scalar reference to nullable declaration requires exact two-key mask0 presenceFlow only on independently proved branch; unrelated matching flow rejects. Condition operand uses original declared mask. No string-tag binding check for identifier undefined.
facts.flow: group presenceFlow absent except at return into declared nullable result; if present it must be exact two-key booleans equal to operand mask. Existing nongroup flow rules remain exact. Every group counts depth/work.
facts.group: kind=group, type=i32, exactly one recursively checked operand. Range first token start through last token end, exactly one outer ( and ), operand strictly inside; comments/trivia allowed, UTF16 surrogate boundaries exact. Operand raw reference/call Node.Pos is the outer open-paren end; nested group/coalesce starts at first token. Type and absence mask come from recursively validated operand, never an omitted flow.

Inequality early return references guarded parameter narrowed to mask0; continuation references a distinct scalar parameter. Existing v5 direct presence guard profiles stay available.
typeofUndefined.proof: Original official GetTypeAtLocation(condition) is boolean-like; typeof result is string-like including literal unions. Operand resolves to the same required parameter ast.Symbol and exact nominal i32 payload/member set. Each actual returned/reference/coalesce use has independently read official type/flow; expected masks only assert these objects and never manufacture union types. Typeof comparison distinguishes undefined only for both strict operators; null is retained on the false equality arm.
typeofUndefined.rejection: No grouped typeof/operand, property, local, call operand, foreign tag, arbitrary string operation, truthiness, branch reassociation, body evaluator, invented tag/payload or DTO-only proof. Existing recursive depth budget includes groups/calls/coalesce in continuation. Loose ==/!= stay prohibited by R01 at every route, in both operand orders. Official diagnostics zero cannot override the language contract.
